explanation: Not stated on erdosproblems.com/22, but it is Szemerédi's classical bound as given in the file's references [Sz72]: for every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that, for large n, K_4-free graphs with α ≤ δn have at most (1/8 + ε)n² edges. The quantifier order is the correct way to state this. I did not read [Sz72], which is in Hungarian; the form agrees with how the Ramsey–Turán density of K_4 is standardly quoted. Faithful.
